title: Kagamine Len — A Moment After School〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Judging from the way you're playing, Len, you seem very happy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? Are you not going to tell us...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Telling them means talking about how Saki came to ask KAITO and me for help...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
“You're not alone.”
“There's a fun future ahead.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's how I'll understand their loneliness...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can keep going...!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Saki already seems to have figured out what was missing from her song.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sorry, but I have to keep it a secret.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That just makes me even more curious.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hmm... What could it be?
Did Saki bring you some delicious snacks?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What's that supposed to mean?
FYI, I'm not Rin.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I can't wait to hear the song Saki comes up with...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Still, I don't really see anything wrong with this one.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: He really seems to enjoy playing that tune.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, he must like it very much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Heya, Ichika, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hi! Pardon the intrusion♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Len, were you just playing...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I've been playing it a lot recently.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But no one at that live house really seemed to like it and one person even told me that it didn't really strike a chord with them...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I still like it.
It's fun, catchy and great to sing to!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-You really think so...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why would I lie to you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, this song not getting the response you were looking for during your show is probably a bit concerning...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I still like playing it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: For example, I really like this part.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, it's that part!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho and I talked a ton about how to make that chord progression feel really good!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Really?
Then, how about this part?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, for that part...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. They certainly seem to be enjoying themselves.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I think her having talked to him and KAITO about songwriting also has something to do with that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: About songwriting? Does this have to do with a different song? Not the one she wrote for you girls to play at that other live house?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. A lot happened after that show and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
I heard a little about that from Honami and Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Including how Saki pushed herself really hard.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: However, this experience may've been a necessary step that she had to take in order to grow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really?! This part's based on that feeling when you're running as fast as you possibly can?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO and I actually talked a lot about what this part represented.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You did?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm starting to get a better understanding of why Len seems so happy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, me too.
